claims.claim: Plus500 said in a Monday trading update that it expects 2026 revenue and EBITDA to beat analyst expectations, after an October 2 statement that it was trading in line with expectations.

claims.supporting_quote: Revenue for the three months to September 30 came in at $203.2 million, an 11% rise on the $182.7 million booked a year ago. EBITDA grew 7% to $88.4 million, a 44% margin.
